title: 第11章 唯一的虚拟世界游戏
content_zh:
第11章唯一的虚拟世界游戏
黎辰安接着看向直播，他身患绝症，这次就是转机。但基因进化法，学习是否有门槛？
“想必大家也知道了，基因进化法学习很难，一旦动作错误，对身体反而有害。实验者都是在虚拟头盔中学习。”安格斯秘书长微笑道，“现在，我便宣布整个蓝星联盟共同的决议！蓝星之上所有人类，只要年满六周岁，便可免费领取一个虚拟头盔。虚拟世界内，所有人类可在十种进化法中任意选择。”
这一宣布，让黎辰安、杨青烁等人都激动，全球各地沸腾，无数人们欢呼。
“如果是身怀绝症的年幼儿童，即便不满六周岁，也可经过申请后，获得虚拟头盔。”安格斯秘书长说道，“虚拟头盔内，为了让大家学习进化法，仅仅创造了一款虚拟世界游戏。”
“虚拟世界游戏，它的创造难度，比创造一座上亿人口的城市，难度还要高得多！结合荧火星上的文明结晶，我们才创出这一款，名为《生命进化》的游戏。”
“《生命进化》游戏，不但可以让大家学会基因进化法，也可以搜集大家在游戏中的身体进化数据。亿万人的进化数据，不断累计不断总结，相信在将来某一天，我们人类也将创造出更强的进化法，让我们人类变得更强大，寿命也更长。”安格斯秘书长说道，“并且在游戏世界的个人空间，也可进行学习、科研，相信我们人类只要齐心合力，一定能在这浩瀚星空中，变得更强，走得更远。”
“科技改变人类。”
“从今天起，我们人类，便进入一个崭新的时代！”安格斯秘书长自豪说道，“关于虚拟头盔，各国都会三天内发放完毕。而《生命进化》游戏则是在京城时间7月25号晚上9点正式开放。”
最后一句话，按照不同翻译，语音也是各有不同。
在樱花国，便是“江户时间7月25号晚上10点正式开放。”
在天竺国，便是“孔雀城时间7月25号晚上6点30正式开放。”
在白鹰联邦，便是“大都会时间7月25号上午8点正式开放。”
在罗马国，便是“雾都时间7月25号晚上下午1点正式开放。”
全球各地人们都在之激动。
在夏国，江南省明月市，许景明家中。
“国家发布通知了，全国各个地区领取虚拟头盔的安排。”黎渺渺连说道。
一旁许老爷子也查看着自己屏幕，笑道：“发布会刚结束，消息就发送过来了，效率还真是高。”
许景明也查看着。
全国各地都有详细安排，明月市也是如此，将各县、各区领取虚拟头盔的地方都已经公布。

“明天下午1点开始领取头盔，我们XC区有十二个领取点。”许景明看完连说，“现在就提交申请，我们就定在最近的领取点——体育馆吧。”
“我们选同一个时间段。”
在场一家人全都提交申请，很快确定领取点——体育馆领取点。
7月22日傍晚5点，明月市XC区体育馆，许景明一家人正在排队。因为每家人都是有规定时间段，所以仅仅排队三分钟便轮到他们了。
“虚拟头盔。”许景明抱着领取的盒子，又好奇又期待。
这是一个新物件，虽然人类对此早有想象，但如今才是真正接触到。
近乎百分百虚拟？真是不可思议。
“走，我们回家。”
许景明、许父许母、许老爷子，还有黎渺渺和其父母，一群人一起离开。而体育馆依旧数百人在鱼贯入内，一边在进入，一边在离开，离开的人们都开心抱着一个个盒子。
而此刻整个夏国，乃至全球各地，不同肤色的不同人们，都在领取着虚拟头盔。
在全球人们的期待中，时间终于来到了7月25日晚上9点。
“阿烁，时间到了，加油。”许景明也和好友视频电话联系着。
“真没想到，我这手还有长出来的机会。”杨青烁眼神中也充满神采，“我们游戏中再见。”
挂了电话。
许景明走进卧室，黎渺渺也和两位女助理们视频电话：“大家加油，《生命进化》游戏，是整个蓝星上几乎所有人类都会玩的一款游戏，热度将远远超越历史上所有游戏。以后我们工作室的战场，就是这款虚拟游戏了。”
“是，老板。”孔姐、小曾两位女助理都齐声应道。
“开始上战场！”黎渺渺握拳，两名女助理也都握拳，黎渺渺随即挂了电话。
许景明看着这幕，不由哑然失笑。
“笑什么笑。”黎渺渺瞥了眼许景明，抱着怀里红色的虚拟头盔，“这虚拟头盔科技含量极高，就算大规模制造，一个成本至少上万吧。全球七十亿个免费发放……这成本想想都惊人。”
许景明点头：“这么大事件，在这次发布会之前，竟然没有任何消息泄露。而且这次真是大手笔，也是造福所有人类，不但让全人类生命进化，寿命翻了一倍。更让人们能将夜间时间也利用起来，人们利用的时间……实际上是过去的四倍。”

“不但如此。”
黎渺渺说道，“而且还因此创造了一款前所未有的游戏。全球七十亿人，年满六周岁就可领取虚拟头盔，你说，领取虚拟头盔，有谁会不登录么？”
“不登录虚拟头盔，那就是放弃四倍生命的机会。”许景明道。
“所以，这款游戏的玩家，是全球几乎所有人。”黎渺渺无比振奋，跟着躺了下来，“不说了，我们赶紧进去吧，我已经迫不及待，想要看一看百分百虚拟的世界了。”
“不知道这游戏世界里面是什么。”许景明也躺在床上，拿起床头柜上的银灰色头盔，“开始吧。”
“虚拟世界！”黎渺渺也很期待。
躺在同一床上的许景明和黎渺渺相视一眼，便都戴上了虚拟头盔。
这一刻，全球各地，无数人们都一个个戴上虚拟头盔，进入虚拟世界。
许景明先是感觉头盔内一个个金属贴着头皮，头皮微微一麻，便觉得意识迅速沉沦。
“许景明，欢迎你来到生命进化世界。”
content_en:
Chapter 11 The Only Virtual World Game
Li Chenan then looked at the live broadcast. He was terminally ill, and this was a turning point. But with genetic evolution, is there a threshold for learning?
"I believe everyone knows that learning the genetic evolution method is difficult. Once the action is wrong, it will be harmful to the body. The experimenters all learn in the virtual helmet." Secretary-General Angus smiled, "Now, I will announce the joint resolution of the entire Blue Star Alliance! All humans on Blue Star, as long as they are six years old or above, can receive a virtual helmet for free. In the virtual world, all humans can choose among the ten evolution methods."
This announcement made Li Chenan, Yang Qingshuo and others excited. The whole world was excited and countless people cheered.
"If you are a young child with a terminal illness, even if you are under six years old, you can get a virtual helmet after applying." Secretary-General Angus said, "In the virtual helmet, in order to let everyone learn the method of evolution, we only created a virtual world game."
"The difficulty of creating a virtual world game is much higher than creating a city with a population of hundreds of millions! Combining the crystallization of civilization on Mars, we created this game called "Life Evolution"."
"The "Life Evolution" game not only allows everyone to learn the genetic evolution method, but also collects everyone's physical evolution data in the game. The evolutionary data of hundreds of millions of people are constantly accumulated and summarized. I believe that one day in the future, we humans will also create a stronger evolution method. , Let us humans become stronger and live longer.” Secretary-General Angus said, “In addition, we can also conduct learning and scientific research in the personal space of the game world. I believe that as long as we humans work together, we will become stronger and go further in this vast starry sky.”
"Technology changes human beings."
"From today on, we humans will enter a new era!" Secretary-General Angus said proudly. "As for the virtual helmets, all countries will distribute them within three days. The "Life Evolution" game will be officially opened at 9 pm on July 25th, Beijing time."
The last sentence has different pronunciation according to different translations.
In Sakura Country, it means "officially opening at 10pm on July 25th, Edo time."
In the country of Tianzhu, it is "Peacock City will officially open at 6:30 pm on July 25th."
In the White Eagle Federation, it is "officially opening at 8 a.m. on July 25, metropolitan time."
In Rome, it means "it will officially open at 1pm on July 25th, foggy time."
People around the world are excited.
In Xia Kingdom, Mingyue City, Jiangnan Province, Xu Jingming's home.
"The state has issued a notice on arrangements for receiving virtual helmets in various regions across the country." Li Miaomiao said.
Mr. Xu on the side also checked his screen and said with a smile: "The message was sent just after the press conference ended. The efficiency is really high."
Xu Jingming also looked at it.
Detailed arrangements have been made across the country, including Mingyue City. The places for receiving virtual helmets in each county and district have been announced.
"Helmets collection will begin at 1 o'clock tomorrow afternoon. We have twelve collection points in the XC area." Xu Jingming said after reading, "Submit the application now, and we will choose the nearest collection point - the gymnasium."
"We choose the same time period."
All the family present submitted their applications, and the collection point was quickly determined - the gymnasium collection point.
At 5 o'clock in the evening on July 22, Xu Jingming's family was queuing up at the XC District Gymnasium in Mingyue City. Since each family has a designated time slot, it only took three minutes for them to wait in line before it was their turn.
"Virtual helmet." Xu Jingming held the box he received, curious and expectant.
This is a new object. Although humans have imagined it for a long time, they are really coming into contact with it now.
Almost 100% virtual? It's incredible.
"Let's go home."
Xu JingMing, Xu's father, Xu's mother, Mr. Xu, and Li Miaomiao and his parents left together. However, hundreds of people were still filing into the gymnasium, entering and leaving at the same time. People leaving were happily holding boxes one by one.
At this moment, in the entire Xia Kingdom, and even around the world, people of different skin colors are receiving virtual helmets.
Amid the expectations of people around the world, the time finally came to 9pm on July 25th.
"A Shuo, it's time, come on." Xu Jingming also contacted his friend via video call.
"I never thought I would have a chance to grow this hand." Yang Qingshuo's eyes were also full of energy, "I'll see you in the game."
Hang up the phone.
Xu Jingming walked into the bedroom, and Li Miaomiao also made a video call with the two female assistants: "Come on, everyone, the game "Life Evolution" is played by almost all humans on the entire Blue Star. Its popularity will far surpass all games in history. From now on, the battlefield of our studio will be this virtual game."
"Yes, boss." The two female assistants, Sister Kong and Xiao Zeng, responded in unison.
"Start going to the battlefield!" Li Miaomiao clenched his fists, and the two female assistants also clenched their fists. Li Miaomiao immediately hung up the phone.
Xu Jingming couldn't help but laugh when he saw this scene.
"Why are you laughing?" Li Miaomiao glanced at Xu Jingming and held the red virtual helmet in his arms. "This virtual helmet has extremely high technological content. Even if it is manufactured on a large scale, it would cost at least tens of thousands. Seven billion of them will be distributed for free around the world...the cost is staggering when you think about it."
Xu Jingming nodded: "For such a big event, no news was leaked before this press conference. Moreover, this is really a big deal, and it benefits all mankind. It not only allows the evolution of all human life, but also doubles the life span. It also allows people to make use of night time. The time people use... is actually four times as much as in the past."
"More than that."
Li Miaomiao said, "And this has created an unprecedented game. Seven billion people in the world can receive virtual helmets when they are six years old or above. You said, who would not log in to receive a virtual helmet?"
"If you don't log in to the virtual helmet, you're giving up the chance of four times your life." Xu Jingming said.
"So, the players of this game are almost everyone in the world." Li Miaomiao was extremely excited and lay down, "Stop talking, let's go in quickly. I can't wait to see the 100% virtual world."
"I don't know what's in this game world." Xu Jingming also lay on the bed and picked up the silver-gray helmet on the bedside table, "Let's get started."
"Virtual world!" Li Miaomiao is also looking forward to it.
Xu Jingming and Li Miaomiao, who were lying on the same bed, looked at each other and put on virtual helmets.
At this moment, countless people around the world are wearing virtual helmets one by one and entering the virtual world.
Xu Jingming first felt the metal inside the helmet sticking to his scalp. His scalp felt slightly numb, and then he felt his consciousness sinking rapidly.
"Xu Jingming, welcome to the world of life evolution."
